tourney.fromTourney: Using the {{n}} players registered in this tourney.
tourney.maxRebuysHelp: On top of the initial buy-in. 0 means no rebuys.

inventory.helpText: The chips you actually own. Click a chip to change its colour or shape.
inventory.empty: No chips yet — add one to get started.
inventory.colorTaken: {{color}} is already used by another chip of this shape
inventory.allColorsUsed: Every colour is in use in both shapes.
inventory.shapeTaken: You already have a {{color}} token of that shape

plan.totalBuyIns: Count out of the box for all {{n}} buy-ins
plan.totalRebuys: Count out of the box for all {{n}} rebuys

colorUps.helpText: Run these at the breaks to keep stacks small. Odd chips are raced off as usual. A chip is retired once it is worth so little that keeping it costs more than rounding a blind.
colorUps.none: No colour up needed — the blinds never outgrow your smallest chip.
colorUps.reserveTitle: Keep these in the bank — don't deal them out in starting stacks

errors.no_chips: Enable at least one chip colour with a value and a quantity.
errors.no_players: Add players to the tourney, or override the player count.
errors.insufficient_value: Not enough chips: this tourney needs more total value than you own.
errors.insufficient_supply: Not enough chips to build every stack. Add more chips or lower the stack size.
errors.starting_stack_unmakeable: This stack can't be made exactly from the chip values you enabled.
errors.rebuy_stack_unmakeable: The rebuy stack can't be made exactly from the chip values you enabled.
errors.oversubscribed: More {{colors}} chips are needed than you own.

warnings.no_chip_divides_blinds: No chip value divides your opening blinds — players won't be able to post them exactly.
warnings.single_denomination: Only one chip value fits this stack, so players get no mix. Enable a larger chip.
warnings.levels_not_payable: Blinds at level {{levels}} can't be paid exactly with the chips in play by then.
warnings.supply_limited: Short on {{colors}} chips — the mix was compromised to fit what you own.
warnings.no_spare_chips: Every {{colors}} chip is committed, leaving no spares.
warnings.rebuy_stack_unmakeable: The rebuy stack can't be built from the chips left after the starting stacks.
warnings.color_up_short: Colour ups can't fully exchange the {{colors}} chips — you need more large chips.
warnings.duplicate_denomination: More than one chip is worth the same amount; {{colors}} ignored.
warnings.supply_forced_large_chip: Short on small chips, so the stack includes a chip worth more than we would normally deal.
warnings.color_up_blocked: No colour up at the break after level {{breaks}}: the blinds at level {{levels}} can't be paid with the next chip up, so the smaller chip has to stay in play.
